thread:
Ellie Chen: Quick sync — launching the 'Serving LLMs at Scale' webinar next Tue 10am PT. Need social plan for X + LinkedIn, assets, and inbound routing. Goal: 1. Drive signups 2. Capture qualified MQLs 3. Test two CTAs for messaging iteration.
Tom Alvarez: Got it. Can we do a carousel on LinkedIn (3 slides) + 1 static post? I can whip up copy, need assets by Friday EOD.
Priya Rao: I can do two headline variants for A/B: Variant A focuses on latency/cost savings, Variant B on reliability & uptime. Will draft by Thu.
Ellie Chen: Perfect. Also need UTM schema and the registration link with tracking so we can route HubSpot leads properly. Sam, can you confirm SDR routing? @Sam G
Sam G: Yep — route signups with utm_campaign=llm-webinar to HubSpot list "Webinar - Redwood" and auto-create a task in sales queue 'webinar-inbound'. I'll add the funnel automation. Can you confirm form fields (company, role, use-case)?
Ellie Chen: Yes: name, email, company, role, monthly usage (opt), use-case (free text). Also add a checkbox for "Open to pilot / dedicated capacity convo" so SDRs can prioritize.
Tom Alvarez: Asset ask: PNG exports for slides + 1:1 hero image + 16:9 preview. Upload to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-redwood/webinar-assets
Priya Rao: For the copy tests, can we try: A) "Cut inference costs while staying lightning-fast." B) "Keep your app online: predictable LLM inference at scale." Short captions for X/LinkedIn will follow.
Ellie Chen: Engagement plan: initial posts (T0), follow-up posts at +24h and +72h, and thread replies for high-engagement comments. Scheduler-bot will queue posts; Tom, choose posting windows: morning and late afternoon on X, mornings on LinkedIn.
scheduler-bot: Scheduled draft created for X at Tue 10:05 PT and LinkedIn at Tue 10:15 PT. To review: https://scheduler.redwood/drafts/1788001234
Tom Alvarez: I'll review & finalize copy by Friday. For the thread replies, can we template two response snippets for common questions (pricing, enterprise/deployment)?
Priya Rao: I'll add 3 suggested reply snippets: pricing pointer, enterprise/private deployment pointer, and a link to docs/whitepaper.
Sam G: For inbound prioritization: add a lead score tag when company size >50 or mentions 'enterprise' in use-case. SDRs will triage daily in #sales-inbound. Also recommend adding a webhook to Slack for high-score leads.
Ellie Chen: Great. Last ask — analytics: set UTM for variants (utm_content=variantA / variantB), and pull signup per variant after 72h to measure lift. Can marketing ops set up a dashboard?
Tom Alvarez: Will add UTM params to final URLs and pin the post copy here when ready. :thumbsup:
Ellie Chen: Thanks team — let's sync Friday 11am to confirm assets and final schedule. If anything slips, post in this thread. :rocket:
